Preparação do Baralho de Saque de Combatentes

notes: Combatant Loot Deck → Baralho de Saque de Combatentes segue a decisão aprovada no glossário (Payload id 18). “Setup” foi traduzido como “Preparação”; a página traduz regras/títulos editáveis, mantendo os nomes de cartas e componentes impressos dentro da arte em inglês.

O título usa uma moldura local PT-BR centralizada no banner; família, tamanho, cor e peso seguem o OG. Copyfit V3 atual: EXACT 1/1 em 100% e 200%; os samples do Viewer confirmam CinzelLocal 18 pt/700 carregada.
OG, Viewer PT-BR, print e PDF persistido foram comparados após a aprovação. A imagem da tabela e das cartas permanece igual à fonte, sem máscara nem overlay.

copyfitMeasurement.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.

artworkExceptionGroups.reason: The current background image contains the four level labels, card captions and item-table text. Existing duplicate DOM title/value lines are suppressed from normal rendering, but no Portuguese artwork replacement exists. Preserve the source art until a page-faithful localized overlay or rebuilt asset is validated. “Nível de Saque” and “Mundano” remain terminology candidates; if the white-die pictogram remains in a later art overlay, do not also spell out “dados” in the adjacent PT label.
